worked_solution:
Taking the antiderivative and evaluating the difference at the bounds, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{3}{e}^{x}\,\text{d}x & ={e}^{x}\,{|}_{0}^{3} \\  & ={e}^{3}-{e}^{0} \\  & ={e}^{3}-1.\end{aligned}
$$
